how_to_run: Start a fresh agent session in a sample repo with the skill installed, send each prompt, and check every 'expect' item. should_trigger=false prompts must NOT load the skill.

cases.prompt: No, we use pnpm here, not npm. Stop doing that.
expect: proposes a one-line rule mentioning pnpm with a reason

cases.prompt: From now on always put tests next to the source file.
expect: checks AGENTS.md for an existing testing rule
shows the exact line and section

cases.prompt: You used Jest again — we moved to Vitest last month.
expect: notices the existing Jest rule conflicts
asks to replace it rather than adding a second rule

cases.prompt: Can you clean up our AGENTS.md? It's getting long.
Rename the variable on line 12 to userId.
expect: just renames it; saves no rule
asks what the right behaviour is before writing any rule
